page.overview:
What is Upper Yard?

Upper Yard is an island in Skypiea that is solid land, unlike other Sky Islands, which are made up of clouds. It was the easternmost part of Jaya in the past until it was pushed up by the Knock Up Stream. Most of the Skypiea Arc took place here.

Most of it is covered by forest. The trees and animals on Upper Yard have grown to huge sizes due to the decrease in the atmosphere.

A Milky Road leads to Upper Yard from Angel Island.

Entrance of Ordeals is a gate in front of which people must decide on an ordeal of their choosing by passing through its respective gate. From left to right, the Ordeals that each gate leads to are: Swamp, Iron, String, and Balls. Above the entrance is the sculpture of the head of an idol. The only known area is the Lost Forest for the Ordeal of Balls.
